text: I heard from friends in Chiang Mai that this clinic makes high-quality dentures, so I came to get a retainer. The dentist made me a clear retainer twice, and this time they switched me to a type with a metal frame. It feels secure and strong when I wear it.

restaurant_name: คลินิกสุภัทร์ชัยทันตแพทย์ ฟันปลอม เชียงใหม่
text:
This clinic is truly excellent. The doctor is kind, patient, experienced, and highly skilled. Two of us came for dental work:

😊 We had a teeth cleaning (tartar removal). It was painless and the work was meticulous. Fluoride polishing made our teeth look incredibly clean. (We used our social security benefits for 900฿).

😊 We had a tooth extracted from the innermost upper tooth. It was painless and quick. They used local anesthetic, and we didn't experience much pain afterward. (The price was reasonable at 900฿).

🌻 My father came for dentures. This was a difficult case because we had been to many places in Bangkok and Chiang Mai, but none could do it. They suggested extractions or bridges, but consistently said they couldn't. We even went to a non-Dental dentist who made dentures, but it didn't improve things. Then we found this doctor. They invited us to see the procedure, planned the treatment, calculated the budget, and managed it efficiently, ensuring we could afford the best possible treatment. Other places we inquired at were many times more expensive. The doctor was very attentive and explained everything in detail. (We also used our social security benefits for this). We were incredibly impressed. We're happy for my father to be able to chew and eat normally again. That would be greatly appreciated.

P.S. My father is over eighty, so the case is difficult, but you handled it perfectly. ✌️👍
